lines.text: Good, I can see the Beijing team joining now. Welcome!
lines.translation: 好，北京团队已经进来了。欢迎！

lines.text: No problem. Can you hear us clearly?
lines.translation: 没关系。能听清我们说话吗？

lines.text: Sure. I said the European pilot starts on June first.
lines.translation: 没问题。我说的是欧洲试点六月一日启动。

lines.text: Great. Let's go around the table — each region gives a quick update.
lines.translation: 好。我们按顺序轮流发言——每个地区简要汇报一下。

lines.text: Impressive. Please hold questions until the end, so we can finish on time.
lines.translation: 很出色。请大家把问题留到最后，保证按时结束。

lines.text: Good call. We're almost out of time, so let's park the last topic.
lines.translation: 说得好。时间快到了，最后一个议题先放一放。

lines.text: Appreciated. Thanks for staying on despite the tech issues. Talk soon.
lines.translation: 非常感谢。谢谢大家克服技术问题坚持开完会。回头再聊。

lines.text: Hi everyone, sorry for joining late — we had trouble with the dial-in number.
lines.translation: 大家好，抱歉来晚了——我们刚才拨入号码时遇到了点问题。

lines.text: You're a bit broken up. Could you repeat the last part?
lines.translation: 你们的声音有点断断续续。能把刚才那段重复一遍吗？

lines.text: Got it, thanks. The connection seems much better now.
lines.translation: 明白了，谢谢。现在连接好像好多了。

lines.text: Beijing first, then. Sales grew twelve percent last quarter, driven by new accounts.
lines.translation: 那北京先来。上季度销售额增长百分之十二，主要由新客户带动。

lines.text: Understood. Could everyone please mute when not speaking? There's some background noise.
lines.translation: 明白。不发言的同事请静音，背景噪音有点大。

lines.text: Fine with us. I'll follow up with an email summarizing our action items.
lines.translation: 我们没问题。会后我会发邮件汇总行动项。

lines.text: Thanks for organizing. Have a great day, everyone.
lines.translation: 谢谢你的组织，祝大家愉快。
